heading: about me!
lead: Building fast, thoughtful web interfaces & reliable network systems.
paragraphs: I'm a Web Developer & Computer Science student based in Bandung, Indonesia, specializing in modern frontend development (Astro, React, TypeScript) and computer networking (MikroTik MTCNA). Working as a Computer Network Lab Assistant has made me stubborn about both clean architecture and rock-solid fundamentals.

That habit follows me into every project. Off the clock I experiment with interactive UIs, dissect complex problems into simple logic, and build web apps just to see how smooth they can feel. This notebook portfolio included.
